text:
Alice: kicking off blue->green shift for svc-api v2. change window 10:30-11:00 PST. plan: weighted drain + warmup. tagging @DeployBot to start.
DeployBot: automated playbook triggered: svc-api v2 deployment id=deploy-1987654322. initial weight plan loaded.
Ben: quick check — health check path still /healthz? any readiness probe changes?
Caroline: yes still /healthz. note: downstream auth service pinned to v1.2.0 until 2h after cutover. keep in mind for error budget.
Dave: latency SLOs: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms. rollback triggers: error rate > 1.5% OR p95 > 500ms sustained 2m.
Erin: ensure session-affinity cookie stays on green during drain. we can't drop sticky sessions mid-request.
Fran: I'll watch infra metrics (cpu/gpu mem) and LB error counters.
DeployBot: Step 0: preflight checks passing (DNS, certs, infra capacity). Step 1: set weights -> green:5%, blue:95%. hold 3m.
Alice: moving to 5% now. command: `curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/weights -d '{"svc":"svc-api","weights":{"green":5,"blue":95}}'`
Ben: looking at 5% logs — no obvious 5xxs so far. minor 429 bursts from one client IP.
Caroline: warming cache on green nodes: `kubectl exec -it pod/svc-api-green-0 -- /bin/warm-cache.sh` (run against all replicas)
DeployBot: hold complete at 5% (3m). metrics: errors 0.2%, p95 160ms.
Alice: proceed to 25%.
DeployBot: setting weights -> green:25%.
Fran: saw error spike to 2.1% 30s after bump; p95 jumped to 620ms for ~40s then trended down to 300ms. alert triggered.
Dave: that's above our rollback threshold. we should hold and assess logs before abort.
Ben: logs show auth timeout errors (502) from the downstream auth service for traffic hitting green nodes. correlation: auth v1.2.0 pinned earlier — could be connection pooling issue.
Caroline: can we reduce concurrency on green to protect auth? e.g., lower replicas or set max-conns per upstream.
Erin: suggest hold at 25% and run a focused warmup: reduce weight to 10% temporarily while we patch auth pool settings.
Alice: agreed. DeployBot, set green->10% and keep blue 90% while we patch.
DeployBot: adjusting weights -> green:10%.
Fran: updating LB timeouts now: upstream auth keepalive 90s -> 120s, reconnect backoff tweaks. patch rolling.
Ben: redeploy auth-proxy with updated pool settings to canary (1 instance) to validate.
DeployBot: auth-proxy canary deploy initiated id=auth-1987654322-canary.
Dave: monitoring p95 and error rate.
DeployBot: canary healthy after 4m. error rate on green down to 0.3%, p95 180ms.
Alice: given canary healthy, proceed with gradual resume: 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100% with 2m steady at each step.
DeployBot: increasing to 25% -> hold 2m.
Fran: metrics stable at 25% (errors 0.4%).
DeployBot: increasing to 50% -> hold 2m.
Ben: p95 220ms at 50% (within SLO), small spike in cpu on green nodes but within headroom.
DeployBot: increasing to 75% -> hold 2m.
Erin: sticky sessions behaving ok. no session loss.
DeployBot: increasing to 100% -> finalizing cutover, draining blue pool.
Alice: note: draining policy = graceful 120s, reject new after drain start.
Fran: drain started. running: `kubectl annotate svc svc-api blue-drain=started --overwrite`
Ben: one tricky client still hitting old endpoints; routing seems to have a cached MX in a partner network. ETA for full propagation unknown.
Dave: maintain 10% fallback capacity on green for 5m as buffer.
DeployBot: cutover complete. all traffic now to green. blue pool decommission scheduled in 30m.
Caroline: start post-cutover smoke tests: run /smoke/api, /smoke/auth, /smoke/long-poll.
Erin: smoke passed except long-poll had increased latency intermittently.
Fran: intermittent long-poll latency correlated with a specific origin (partner A). added a targeted rate-limit on that origin.
Alice: schedule a short follow-up at +15m to confirm stability. hold decommission until then.
(15m later)
Fran: stability check: overall errors 0.12%, p95 190ms, infra healthy. blue decommission can proceed.
DeployBot: blue pool decommission started: `asgard decomm svc-api blue --keep-snapshots`.
Ben: decommission completed. final note: document auth pool changes and partner-specific rate-limit in release notes.
Alice: thanks team. postmortem not expected unless new regressions surface. :thumbsup
